answer: A saffron-marked challenge round lets peers flag duplicates, while a rotating lantern of audited witnesses confirms each claim. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond before earning, and reputation accrues on a shared trellis of verified work, so fake accounts burn capital with no payout. Attackers must fund every clone and forfeit bonds on detection, making mass identity farming costlier than legitimate participation. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
